title: Underwriting Guideline: Binding a CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy
content:
1. A CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy is bound only on a unit in an association that carries a master policy, and only on a tier whose entry requirements the applicant meets.
2. Coverage A is at least the tier's minimum for the association's master policy type and at most the tier's maximum Coverage A. The minimum is the tier's bare-walls minimum, single-entity minimum or all-in minimum according to the master policy type.
3. Coverage C lies within the tier's minimum and maximum Coverage C; personal liability is one of the tier's liability limits; the deductible is one of the tier's deductible options; the loss assessment limit starts at the tier's included loss assessment limit and the water backup limit at the tier's included water backup limit; and the billing plan is one of the plans the tier allows.
4. A unit rented to others is bound only on a tier that allows a unit rented to others to be insured with the rental endorsement, and only with the unit rental endorsement; on other tiers a rented unit is insured under a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy instead.
5. A unit already insured under a live HomeGuard Homeowners Policy is never also insured under CondoGuard.
6. A bound policy moves to in force on its effective date, and the term runs twelve calendar months.

## The Coverage A test at binding

The master policy type is taken from the association's master policy on file; the Coverage A amount is the amount the applicant asks to bind; both belong to the same customer and the same unit address.

| Association's master policy type | Minimum that applies |
|---|---|
| bare walls | the tier's bare-walls minimum |
| single entity | the tier's single-entity minimum |
| all-in | the tier's all-in minimum |

## Cases (hypothetical tier figures: bare-walls minimum 60000 USD, single-entity minimum 25000 USD, maximum 200000 USD)

- Single entity master policy, Coverage A requested 25000 USD: exactly at the minimum, so it qualifies.
- Single entity master policy, Coverage A requested 24000 USD: below the minimum, so it does not qualify.
- Bare walls master policy, Coverage A requested 50000 USD: below the bare-walls minimum of 60000 USD, so it does not qualify, although it would clear the single-entity minimum.
- Bare walls master policy, Coverage A requested 200000 USD: exactly at the maximum, so it qualifies; 210000 USD would not.
